basic_details.job_title: SFIO Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline for 42 Joint Director, Deputy Director and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Joint Director (Capital Market), Joint Director (Forensic Audit), Deputy Director (Corporate Law) and 12 more
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level 12, 11, 10 and 8 (7th CPC pay matrix) plus Special Security Allowance at 20% of basic pay

how_to_apply: Forward the application, complete in all respects, through proper channel in the prescribed proforma to The Director, Serious Fraud Investigation Office, Pt. Deendayal Antyodaya Bhawan, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003, by Speed Post.
Send it within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News.
Separate applications may be forwarded for each post.
Enclose self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications, ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, Vigilance Clearance Certificate, Integrity Certificate and the major/minor penalty certificate.
Make sure it reaches by 20 January 2027.
important_instructions: Applications received without ACRs/APARs, Vigilance Clearance, self-attested copies of educational qualification, etc. or otherwise found incomplete will not be considered. The Cadre Controlling Authority may also certify that the particulars furnished by the officer have been verified and found correct.

Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay is given as pay matrix level under 7th CPC; selected candidates also get Special Security Allowance at 20% of basic pay; no deputation allowance along with SSA. Deputation (including short-term contract) basis. Number of posts is tentative and may increase or decrease on administrative grounds.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications Up-to-date ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, attested on each page by an officer of Under Secretary level or above Vigilance Clearance Certificate Integrity Certificate Certificate of major/minor penalty imposed during the last 10 years

content_sections.text: Applications received without ACRs/APARs, Vigilance Clearance, self-attested copies of educational qualification, etc. or otherwise found incomplete will not be considered. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SFIO Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SFIO Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There are 42 vacancies: 1 Joint Director (Capital Market), 1 Joint Director (Forensic Audit), 4 Deputy Director (Corporate Law), 2 Deputy Director (Forensic Audit), 4 Deputy Director (Investigation), 1 Principal Private Secretary and 9 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SFIO Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed proforma (not attached to the notice text)) and send it to The Director, Serious Fraud Investigation Office, Pt. Deendayal Antyodaya Bhawan, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003, by speed post, to reach by 20 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
